title: Every phase PR has evidence-backed task table, counts and trusted sync policy
summary: Implemented versioned phase-scoped PR task manifests, generated task status/count table in PR #1, guarded body-only GitHub sync and a trusted-default-branch CI-success sync workflow. migration_notes: New versioned manifest under docs/state/pr-tasks; old PR body text is preserved outside the managed block.
